claims.text: Our method focuses on multi-lingual vision-and-language navigation, utilizing a cross-lingual representation that captures visual concepts, which differs from traditional methods like VQA and captioning that do not emphasize navigation.

We address the challenge of navigating unseen environments by learning an environment-agnostic visual representation, which is not a focus in existing methods such as multilingual image captioning or retrieval.
Our approach improves instruction-path grounding by using paired multilingual instructions, enhancing the learning process compared to monolingual methods used in existing tasks.
